Name: Hoge Veluwe National Park on the white bikes
Tip: Come early, take a bike and ride to the furthest target first – it gets busier in the afternoon.

Name: Kröller-Müller Museum & sculpture garden
Tip: Go to the sculpture garden after the museum if you still have energy – it is especially lovely in sun.

Name: Airborne Museum Hartenstein & Oosterbeek cemetery
Tip: Plan the visit before the bridge – then you see the place with different eyes.

Name: Eusebius Church & old town
Tip: The tower is not always open – check times beforehand and plan it for good weather.

Name: Netherlands Open Air Museum
Tip: Perfect for rainy days and families – plan three to four hours.

Name: Burgers' Zoo
Tip: Come in the morning when the animals are more active and it is quieter.

Name: Sonsbeek Park
Tip: Pack a picnic and sit by one of the ponds.

Name: Hunting lodge Sint Hubertus & the deer rut
Tip: Go early or in the evening in autumn – then the chances of roaring stags are best.

Name: Klarendal – Arnhem’s fashion district
Tip: Come in the afternoon and on a day when shops are open – not on Monday.

Name: Posbank & Veluwezoom – heath with a view
Tip: Come for the heather bloom in August/September – best in the early morning.

Name: Arnhemse Meisjes – the pastry from Arnhem
Tip: Buy them fresh from a bakery in the centre and eat them with coffee.
